title: ScheduleUpdateArguments
description: The arguments of the `schedule_update` tool (`pipeshub@schedules/update`, ADR-SCH-03 D4): one change to one of the caller's own schedules, as its person sees it on the approval card, and exactly what `POST /api/v1/agent-harness/internal/runs/{runId}/schedules/{id}/update` accepts as `arguments` (its `id` the path's). Either field changes (`name`, `ask`, `when`, `notify`, at least one) or one `action`, never both: the generated models cannot say so, so every validator checks it in code and the vectors hold both sides to it. Shape and lengths only, as `schedule-create-arguments`; whether the change can be made (a one-off that ran, the cron floor, the one-off's window, channels the org allows) is Node's check at the change.

id.description: The schedule's id, as `schedule_find` answered it; never a name.

revision.description: The schedule's `revision` as read before asking: a schedule that changed since is not changed (`SCHEDULE_CHANGED`).

name.description: The schedule's name; not only spaces.

ask.description: What each run is asked, written so it stands alone; not only spaces.

at.description: An ISO 8601 instant with its offset (`Z` or `±hh:mm`), seconds optional, at most 3 fractional digits.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`; whether it is known is checked in code.
An IANA time zone name, e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`; whether it is known is checked in code.

when.description: One of the two kinds: `kind` tells them apart, so at most one branch ever matches.

notify.description: Where the person hears that a run ended; absent: in the app. Never null.

action.description: Pause, resume, skip its next run, or run it now; alone, without field changes.

examples.ask: Tell me a short animal joke.
